TFROM=0x440  # T of base path

MAXT=0x440+0x900

solutions=defaultdict(list)

    if T>MAXT: return
    if len(seq)>200: return
    if state=='SP':
        # scream
        dfs('SP', T+0x120, seq+["3","5"], budget-1)
        # to initial_call
        dfs('IC', T+0x120, seq+["1"], budget-1)

        dfs('TS', T+0x180, seq+["4"], budget-1)
